title: The Big Storm
hook: 雨云一路追着他们跑，唱首歌真的能把雨赶走吗？

cells.en: Dora looks up at the clouds. A big storm is coming soon!
cells.cn: Dora 抬头看云，乌云越聚越多，一场大暴风雨要来了。

cells.en: Map shows the quick way home before the big storm comes.
cells.cn: 地图指了一条最快的回家路，要赶在暴风雨前面到家。

cells.en: First the bush, then the forest, then Dora's house!
cells.cn: 先穿过灌木丛，再穿过森林，最后就到 Dora 的家。

cells.en: They sing, “Rain, rain, go away. Come again some other day!”
cells.cn: 他们一起唱《雨啊雨啊快走开》，想把雨云赶跑。

cells.en: The wind breaks Benny's tree house. They need pieces of wood.
cells.cn: 大风吹坏了 Benny 的树屋，得先找木片才能修。

cells.en: Here is a red triangle. It can be the roof of the house!
cells.cn: 找到一块红色的三角形木片，正好可以当屋顶。

cells.en: Tico must take the blue path. They shout “Azul!” to help him.
cells.cn: Tico 得走蓝色那条路，大家喊“Azul”（蓝色）给他指路。

cells.en: The tree house is fixed and the rain stops. Everyone shouts, “Yay!”
cells.cn: 树屋修好了，雨也停了，大家高兴地欢呼起来。

cells.en: A big rainbow comes out. They stopped the storm together!
cells.cn: 天边出现一道大彩虹——他们真的把暴风雨赶走了。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Big Storm”.
ending: In the end, they fix the tree house and the rain stops. My favorite part is ______.
